Subject: OrbitWay co-sell runbook + calendar safety net

Team,

OrbitWay (APAC SI) is confirmed for a co-sell demo week-of Feb 7. They've requested a dry-run and an explicit buffer for regional handoffs because their engineering and customer stakeholders are split across IST/SGT. Objectives: confirm hosts (Redwood + OrbitWay), rehearse the AWS credentials/VPN validation, and lock a fallback window in case latency tests or model/cost discussion runs long.

Quick asks: 
- Aditya: can you confirm the primary SDR/AE on the external thread and whether marketing wants a short slide deck intro?
- Vanessa: can you own the runbook consolidation and send the first draft (dry-run checklist + failure-mode steps)?
- Olga: please confirm whether we have a dedicated AWS engineer available for rehearsal (30–45m) the day before the customer demo.

I attached a first-pass runbook (runbook-v1.pdf). Plan to keep rehearsal <= 60m and then a 2h buffer on demo day (split into two 1h blocks) to absorb any cross-region handoffs.

If everyone is good I will open a single calendar invite with a rehearsal + buffer and ask OrbitWay to accept.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
